visualize_image_grid: visualize a tf.data.Dataset as a grid of images with labels using ImageGridVisualizer
display_dataset_images: display dataset images in a configurable grid with rows, cols, and plot_scale parameters
match_visualizer_dataset: match ImageGridVisualizer against a DatasetInfo to check if it has image features
auto_detect_image_key: auto-detect the image key from dataset features when multiple image features exist
add_image_to_axes: add a single image to a matplotlib axes with automatic grayscale conversion for single-channel images
